content: How should I calculate the Battery Efficiency Ratio (BER)? What columns and formula should I use?

args.sql:
SELECT 
  a.audregistry as audio_id,
  d.makername as maker,
  d.modnum as model,
  t.battlifeh,
  d.pwractmw,
  ROUND(CAST((t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah::numeric) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) AS numeric), 2) as ber
FROM audioandmedia a
JOIN deviceidentity d ON a.auddevref = d.devregistry
JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
WHERE ROUND(CAST((t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah::numeric) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) AS numeric), 2) > 7.5
ORDER BY ber DESC
LIMIT 10;

  a.audregistry as audio_id,
  d.makername as maker,
  d.modnum as model,
  t.battlifeh,
  d.pwractmw,
  ROUND(CAST((t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah::numeric) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) AS numeric), 2) as ber,

ORDER BY ber DESC;
